## Analysis

Tabu exactly reproduced `sol_0001`, showing the incumbent is a strict or very sticky one-replacement basin; exhaustive local choice and short random kicks add no value there. Together with annealing, this refutes spending another run on fixed-\(n\), single-coordinate refinement. The consistent \(n=17\), span-33 outcome supports density, but does not establish that 17 is optimal; escaping likely requires coordinated membership changes while retaining collision structure. A distributional search over whole set masks is materially different and can learn correlated dense regions without committing to a prescribed interval-plus-fringe form.

## Next

Run a 155-second cross-entropy search on inclusion masks over `[0,63]`: sample 2048 masks per generation with Bernoulli probabilities, keep the best 64 by exact \(C\), update probabilities with smoothing `alpha=0.20`, and inject `sol_0001` plus 128 mutations of each elite. Enforce `12 <= n <= 40`, restart probabilities after 25 stagnant generations, and atomically checkpoint every improvement.
